alignments.note: Anarthrous Piel participle takes the supplied *He that* (rule 46); headed on *delicately*, the word carrying פָּנַק's lexeme, since *bringeth up* alone does not write the pampering (rule 31).
נֹעַר with the indefinite article it licenses.
The ASV opens the apodosis with no connective, so this waw is unrendered (rule 14).
אַחֲרִית rendered *at the last*, headed on the word carrying the lexeme (rule 31).

Corrected. The 3ms suffix on אַחֲרִית denotes the servant, and the ASV's recasting of *his end shall be* as *shall have him become* realizes that suffix by the pronoun *him*: rule 18 aligns a suffix to whatever English pronoun realizes it, and rule 30 reserves `added` for English no morpheme licenses at all. The prior alignment marked the suffix `unrepresented` and the pronoun `added`, which left a written morpheme holding nothing beside a pronoun that denotes exactly its referent.

יִהְיֶה rendered *Shall have ... become*; headed on *become*, the word carrying the copular lexeme. Rule 43 does not send the *have* elsewhere, since no possessive preposition, suffix-of-possession or verb of allotment stands in the clause. Discontinuous around the suffix's *him* under rule 25.
מָנוֹן with the indefinite article it licenses; the ASV's note that the word's meaning is doubtful does not move the unit (rule 38).

review_notes: The one change gives *him* to the suffix of אַחֲרִיתוֹ, dropping the prior `added` pronoun and `unrepresented` suffix. *Shall have ... become* remains the verb's own rendering.
